methodology: Dated public summary of direct archive and public-record correspondence. Sending an enquiry does not prove agency receipt; a reply is not a FOIA decision or permission to republish records. Exact correspondence dates not verified from original messages are explicitly marked as unknown. Records are updated manually, not through automatic inbox monitoring. File-specific copyright licences are distinguished from blanket reuse approvals; where the licensed online publication format is unclear, no document is reproduced pending confirmation.

records.title: Navy UAP videos · FOIA referral records
records.question: What happened to the seven documents (151 pages) referred by the Navy concerning the release of the FLIR1, Gimbal and GoFast videos?
records.sourceWarning: The Navy’s 8 July 2025 response identifies the 151-page referral. WHS’s 14-page release covers case tracking, referral and correspondence. Separate Pentagon FOIA cases 19-F-1420 and 20-F-1095 have their own records.
records.statusDetail: Washington Headquarters Services (WHS) released 14 pages of referral, tracking and correspondence records in its 19 November 2026 final response to Disclosure Desk’s FOIA request 27-F-0917. The packet identifies 25-F-3215 as the Pentagon’s case for the seven referred documents. WHS said that case remained open, with a final decision pending. The seven documents are still outstanding as of that response.
records.requestMethod: WHS received the records request dated 17 November 2026 on 18 November and assigned case 27-F-0917.
records.evidenceRequirement: A release or final agency decision under case 25-F-3215 would establish the outcome for the seven referred documents.

records.agency: Gesellschaft zur Erforschung des UFO-Phänomens (GEP), Germany
records.title: German GEP UFO/UAP case dataset
records.question: May Disclosure Desk import or reproduce GEP's UFO/UAP case dataset in a commercial public research service, and what source-linking is permitted?
records.sourceWarning: GEP is an independent research association, not a German government department. A publicly viewable or downloadable dataset is not permission for commercial reuse or redistribution.
records.statusDetail: GEP declined permission for commercial reuse of its case dataset. We will not bulk import, mirror or map its records from that dataset. Links to the original public research source remain the permitted discovery route. Exact original request and response timestamps are not published until rechecked.
records.requestMethod: Direct request for dataset reuse permission; precise send date pending correspondence verification.
records.evidenceRequirement: A new explicit permission or clear licence grant from GEP would be needed before using the protected dataset in the commercial service.

timeline.title: Permission position recorded by this date

The provided licence does not clearly select the Internet or electronic-publication format, so website reproduction remains on hold pending written clarification.

disclosure.updatePolicy: Manual, dated and evidence-limited: 'sent' is not 'received'; 'response received' confirms only a reply and must not imply FOIA acceptance, case disposition, dataset permission or endorsement. Unverified correspondence dates remain unpublished. No private emails, personal contact details, or raw messages appear on the public site.
